# `outputs/`

**Light outputs are intentionally empty in the repository.** Every file under `outputs/SQ1/` and `outputs/SQ2/` (the light ELAS u4 outputs) is regenerated by running the corresponding `code/SQx/` scripts on a fresh clone. The directory structure is preserved through `.gitkeep` files. The heavy outputs under `outputs/SQ1_heavy/` and `outputs/SQ2_heavy/` (ELAS h3, GPU) **are committed** as evidence, because they cannot be regenerated on a CPU.

This is the central reproducibility-rule of the repo:

> The light thesis outputs must be re-derivable from `code/` + `data/` + this README, without any committed light `outputs/` files. The heavy (GPU) outputs are committed because a fresh CPU clone cannot reproduce them.

## What ends up here after a full run

| Folder        | Files (after `code/SQx/` is run)                                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `outputs/SQ1/`| `simulations/datasets/foras_xlsx_baseline.csv` + per-condition `with_sentinels_*.csv`; `simulations/runs/seed_NNN__{baseline,raw,period,full}/` with `recall_curve.csv`, `results.csv`, `summary.json`; `simulations/summary.json` (aggregate); `figures/intro_terminology_drift.png` |
| `outputs/SQ2/`| `simulations/cell_pp{pp}_nn{nn}_seed{s}/summary.json` × 180; `grid_summary.csv`; `figures/heatmap_grid.png`, `term_distribution.png` |
| `outputs/SQ1_heavy/`| **committed** — per-run results + summaries, `u4_vs_h3_comparison.{csv,md}`, `figures/recall_curves_heavy.png`, `sq1_sentinel_discovery_heavy.png` |
| `outputs/SQ2_heavy/`| **committed** — 36-cell grid summaries (`grid_summary.csv`), `figures/heatmap_grid_heavy.png` |
